author: Dungel, W. and others
title: Measurement of the form factors of the decay $B^0 \to D^{*-} \ell^+ \nu$ and determination of the CKM matrix element $|V_{cb}|$
abstract: This article reports a measurement of the form factors of the decay $B^0 \to D^{*-} \ell^+ \nu$ and a determination of the CKM matrix element $|V_{cb}|$. The results are based on a data sample of 652 million $B\bar{B}$ pairs collected at the $\Upsilon(4S)$ resonance with the Belle detector at the KEKB asymmetric-energy $e^+ e^-$ collider. We find $|V_{cb}| = (39.34 \pm 0.63 (\text{stat}) \pm 1.08 (\text{syst})) \times 10^{-3}$.
